card.name: Words inside ALL-CAPS warning sentences
card.fires_on: Words in an ALL-CAPS warning or note, usually the first or second word after a heading such as NOTE: or WARNING:. It fires on short words like THE, ARE, IS, or on the start of a long capitalized word.

modes.label: Short word after caps heading
modes.description: A short capitalized word such as THE or IS opening an all-caps caution sentence.
modes.example: NOTE:<< THE>> RECONSTITUTED SOLUTION SHOULD NOT

modes.label: Start of a capitalized long word
modes.description: The first piece of a long capitalized warning term, split into parts.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a warning is written in all capital letters.
